note: A shaded streamside site in a small clearing beside Right Branch Young Womans Creek Road near the Bull Run Trail, about 6.7 miles up the road from North Bend (0.7 mile on Main Street from PA 120, then straight on). Parking is parallel on gravel with a shared driveway; the site is listed as 35 by 95 ft with 18 ft of overhead clearance. Sold for trailers and RVs only, no tents, and a self-contained toilet is required. The agency cautions that the site is reached by remote state forest dirt or gravel roads and may not suit some low-clearance vehicles or large RVs. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: 028 Bull Run still listed, Drive-In, Trailer Site category only, max vehicle 25 ft (equipment length 35), parallel gravel, clearance 18 ft; count 1 and max 25 confirmed, pull_through false added. Season year-round confirmed (sells in all three windows). Fees confirmed, $6.50 fee added; facilities none. The road advisory on the Left Branch does not touch this site (Right Branch). Imagery (leaf-off): an open clearing at the pin with a small structure about 15 m north and the creek and a road bridge about 25-30 m south-east; not moved. NHD: Young Womans Creek 38 m, Bull Run 43 m (waterfront lead).
flags: Agency access statements (in the note): 'Caution: This campsite is accessed by remote state forest dirt or gravel roads and may not be suitable for some low-clearance vehicles or large RVs.' No Severe grade, no 4WD requirement or recommendation specific to the site, no wet-weather wording; overhead clearance 18 ft. Kept. The Sproul advisory closing Left Branch Young Womans Creek Road does not name the Right Branch road this site is on.

GIS layer vs booking page: TrailerAccess 'Yes', NumberVehicles 1, 'Sproul State Forest. Motorized camping only, no tents. Self-contained toilets required. Right hand branch, 7.5 miles from Y in road by LHBYWC sign.' Agrees with the Trailer Site category. The mileage differs from the booking page's (6.7 miles from the end of Main Street); the booking page's figure is used in the note.
'Max Vehicle Length: 25' with 'Equipment Length: 35' on the same page; max_rig_ft stays at the lower figure.

WATERFRONT (lead only, not written): the page says 'Streamside campsite along Right Branch of Young Womans Creek near Bull Run Trail' and 'Distance to Lake/Stream: Less than 300 feet'; NHD puts Young Womans Creek 38 m and Bull Run 43 m from the pin. Leaf-off imagery shows the pin on an open clearing and the creek about 25-30 m to the south-east at a road bridge, with a line of trees along the bank between. Close to the 50 m test but the bank is treed; stays not waterfront.
Pin: stored pin = booking point = GIS point (1 m), on the clearing. Not moved. Site 025 Oxbow (entry 15273) is 3.6 km west on the other branch; separate.

ATV check (ruling 1): the DCNR Sproul roadside-campsites map (05/02/2025) draws the numbered and CR-series sites as ordinary roadside campsites and shows the 'Whiskey Springs ATV Area Campsites' (WS series) as a separate inset; this site is not one of them and no agency page places it in an ATV parking lot. The Sproul advisories page does warn 'Stay Alert for ATVs on Roads' (the Northcentral Regional ATV Trail uses some forest roads). Kept.

Agency pages disagree on the district's own inventory: the Sproul camping page says 'Sproul State Forest offers nine roadside campsites for overnight camping in RVs. No tent camping permitted. Self-contained toilets are required.' while the district's 2025 map labels CR001-CR021 plus the WS series, and the CR booking pages list 'Tent Site, Trailer Site'. Nothing here depends on it.
